A portable engine for games made with Adv98V 1.70.54, the PC-9801 adventure engine of Cat's
Pro. Adv98X runs a game's original scripts unmodified and reproduces its PC-98 release: text,
pictures, palette effects, menus, click maps, saves and the FM music (with a light FM emulation
made for these machines).

This archive holds only the engine. It contains none of the game.
